name: Asahi (Chiba, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Asahi city emblem in navy and green: a navy stylised letter J-like swirl with a green disc.
history: Municipal flag of Asahi, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 October 2005.

features.role: Asahi city emblem — a navy stylised letter J-like swirl with a green disc
